== Directors' poll ==
[[File:Stanley Kubrick The Exhibition - LACMA - 2001 A Space Odyssey - Space suits (8999720714).jpg|thumb|right|Props of ''2001, A Space Odyssey'']]
In the 2022 directors' poll, ''[[2001: A Space Odyssey (film)|2001: A Space Odyssey]]'' was ranked first,<ref>{{Cite web |title=Directors' 100 Greatest Films of All Time |url=https://www.bfi.org.uk/sight-and-sound/directors-100-greatest-films-all-time |access-date=2022-12-01 |website=BFI |language=en}}</ref> replacing ''[[Tokyo Story]]'' from 2012 and ''[[Citizen Kane]]'', which held the top spot in both of the directors' polls previous to that.

The top 10 from the directors' list are:

# <li value="1">''[[2001: A Space Odyssey (film)|2001: A Space Odyssey]]'' ([[Stanley Kubrick]], 1968)
# <li value="2">''[[Citizen Kane]]'' ([[Orson Welles]], 1941)
# <li value="3">''[[The Godfather]]'' ([[Francis Ford Coppola]], 1972)
# <li value="4">''[[Jeanne Dielman, 23 quai du Commerce, 1080 Bruxelles]]'' ([[Chantal Akerman]], 1975)
# <li value="4">''[[Tokyo Story]]'' ([[Ozu Yasujiro]], 1953)
# <li value="6">''[[Vertigo (film)|Vertigo]]'' ([[Alfred Hitchcock]], 1958)
# <li value="6">''[[8½]]'' ([[Federico Fellini]], 1963)
# <li value="8">''[[Mirror (1975 film)|Mirror]]'' ([[Andrei Tarkovsky]], 1975)
# <li value="9">''[[Close-Up (1990 film)|Close-up]]'' ([[Abbas Kiarostami]], 1989)
# <li value="9">''[[In the Mood for Love]]'' ([[Wong Kar Wai]], 2000)
# <li value="9">''[[Persona (1966 film)|Persona]]'' ([[Ingmar Bergman]], 1966)
